title: Eastern Range Weather Ops Hub
lede: Custom in-house weather tools built for Eastern Range operations, gathered in one place for testing and feedback.

categories.name: Situational awareness
categories.blurb: The big picture across the range, right now

categories.name: Forecast products
categories.blurb: Official products forecasters build and publish

categories.name: Model guidance
categories.blurb: Post-processed model output for the Cape sites

categories.name: Research and training
categories.blurb: ML projects, competitions and teaching tools

tools.name: Eastern Range Weather COP
tools.description: Common operating picture of current and forecast weather across the Eastern Range.

tools.name: WXR Situational Awareness Dashboard
tools.description: Ops floor dashboard with Merlin lightning against warning rings, field mills, KSC and Cape wind and temperature towers with alerts, METARs and TAFs, the MLB discussion, tropics and the XMR sounding.

tools.name: Southeast Moisture Loop
tools.description: Looping MIMIC total precipitable water with HRRR, GFS or ECMWF forecast tails, GOES-19 imagery, GLM lightning, point PW history and GIF export.

tools.name: CloudScope Radar
tools.description: Live MRMS radar, lightning and field mills scored against the LLCC as if the flight path ran through every point, with cross-sections and pad readouts.

tools.name: CloudScope Model Outlook
tools.description: Model-forecast cloud type and LLCC violation probability across the spaceport corridor, with simulated reflectivity, cross-sections and run-to-run trends.

tools.name: ECMWF MOS
tools.description: MOS-style text guidance from the ECMWF IFS for KXMR, KTTS, KMLB and KCOF: temperature, dewpoint, wind, and precipitation and thunder probabilities.

tools.name: Aviation & Launch Commit Grid
tools.description: Hour-by-hour grid of aviation and launch variables (ceilings, shear, freezing levels, cloud tops) for Cape pads and airfields, plus HREF lightning, skew-Ts and IVT.

tools.name: LLCC Probability Board
tools.description: Probability of violating each NASA-STD-4010B lightning launch commit criterion plus an overall probability, in 3-hour windows out 7 days with a custom window.

tools.name: Daily Planning Forecast
tools.description: Forecaster-editable zone planning forecast for KSC, Cape Canaveral SFS and Patrick SFB, published to CSV and Excel.

tools.name: Exposure Forecast Tool
tools.description: Tailored forecast for a specific operation at any launch pad, the SLF, XMR or a custom point, checked against your own wind and temperature constraints over a custom time range.

tools.name: KCOF TAF Generator
tools.description: Draft 30-hour Air Force TAF for Patrick SFB in AFMAN 15-129 format, for forecasters to refine before issuing.

tools.name: 7-Day Constraint Board (SLF page)
tools.description: Multi-model probabilities for each 7-day constraint at KTTS (crosswinds, head and tailwinds, precip within 30 nm) with CSV export.

tools.name: SLC-40/39A 200 ft Wind Constraints
tools.description: Hourly 200 ft and onshore wind constraint outlook for SLC-40 and LC-39A from every model in the pipeline, including HRRR, HREF, RRFS and REFS. Limits are demo values.

tools.name: Splashdown Weather
tools.description: Splashdown constraint board for recovery sites off the Southern California coast.

tools.name: Weeks 2–6 Outlook
tools.description: Sub-seasonal temperature and precipitation outlook maps for CONUS from GEFS and ECMWF with probabilistic bias correction.

tools.name: KXMR Sounding Climatology
tools.description: Climatology of Cape Canaveral (KXMR) soundings for comparing today’s profile against what’s typical for the date.

tools.name: Cizek Lightning Random Forest Tool
tools.description: Random forest lightning prediction for the Cape, trained on about 30 years of wet-season KXMR soundings.

tools.name: GR2 Launch Weather Replay
tools.description: Builds downloadable GR2Analyst scenarios for past events: radar plus the tower, field mill and MERLIN placefiles for the date and time window you pick.

tools.name: Thor’s Forecast Challenge
tools.description: TAF-style forecast builder for any ICAO site with obs comparison, workbook output and autograding for TFC26.
